arguments.sql: SELECT MIN(t.date) AS first_fraud_date, MAX(t.date) AS last_fraud_date FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Returns the date and time of the earliest and the latest transaction labelled as fraud.
assumptions: Only transactions with a fraud label of 1 count; transactions with no label are left out.
